invariants.rationale: The method returns false if the texts are equal; otherwise it may return true, depending on the rest of the logic.
If newText equals oldText, the method returns false.
The method directly calls newText.equals(...), thus newText cannot be null at this point.
oldText is used in .equals and assignment logic, suggesting it is not null.
If the method returns false, the only path is if newText.equals(oldText).
